title: Recall: Import paths and resolve name collisions
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

alias.clue: At the crate root with modules raw and clean each exporting fn value() -> u32, write one grouped use statement importing raw::value as raw_value then clean::value as clean_value. Start at crate and include the semicolon.

local.clue: Inside the adjust module, write a use statement importing its own scale function with an explicit current-module path prefix. Include the semicolon.
